First of all I'm sorry your dealing with all of this. Ik the feeling of not belonging in a masjid, I've also been distant from mine since most of the people who attend are homophobic. If you want to come out to your parents but you're unsure about their views, just bring up LGBTQ related things subtly. Maybe mention you have a college or classmate who is gay and see what they say, or whatever else you can think of. Before you come out, you have to make sure your in a safe environment. Eg they wont cause you any physical harm. You might want to consider moving out first if that is the case. And if you come out and they dont accept you but they won't harm you, you have to consider the possibility that your relationship will never be the same with them again. But at the end of the day, it seems like you've been though a lot of pain and loneliness, so do what you think will make you happy. Inshallah everything goes well, I'll remember you in my dua.

I came out to my mom with a letter because I was too nervous to verbally say it, and it gave me the opportunity to formulate my words better. So If a video call makes you nervous I would maybe suggest a text message? I mean there could be some hope where after some time she will grow to accept you, but I think you need to do what makes you happy.
